_note: Voices for the Ledger take on the 'huss huss huss / while they're out partying' meme (original parody lines). Deadpan narration by the student, panting 'Huss' between lines. FAR is said as the word 'far'.

lines.text: In this town, everybody goes out partying.
lines.say: In this town... everybody goes out partying.

lines.text: While they're out partying, I'm locked in on FAR.
lines.say: While they're out partying... I'm locked in on far.
